recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, minimalist portrait composition featuring a female subject positioned on the right third, set against a bright white background with subtle geometric architectural shadows. The top of the frame is defined by a solid sky-blue horizontal bar containing stylized typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's warm skin tones against a cool sky-blue header
High-key white negative space balancing the detailed portrait
Sharp, thin geometric lines in the background echoing the linear typography
Horizontal header bar grounding the verticality of the subject
coreInvariants: Solid sky-blue horizontal header at the top edge
Subject positioned in the right half of the frame
Subtle, angular shadows in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium close-up, positioned in the right third of the frame, looking toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the solid blue header bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move upward to the blue header, then sweep across the white negative space on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white negative space on the left two-thirds of the image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background and clothing for a clean, high-key look.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Sky blue header bar providing a cool structural element.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm honey-blonde hair and golden skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation environment with moderate saturation in the subject's features.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal bars on specific characters
Tight kerning for the primary name
Wide tracking for the secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 't' features a crossbar that extends horizontally to frame adjacent letters
Lowercase 'l' and 'u' are simplified to geometric stems

composition.position: Top left within the blue bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a bold, modified display name and a light, widely-spaced subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a woman with honey-blonde hair, wearing white, positioned on the right side. The background is a bright white room with very faint, sharp geometric shadows of walls or pillars. Leave the top 15% of the image as a solid sky-blue horizontal band.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase geometric sans-serif text in white inside the blue band. The primary name should be on the left with a custom extended 't' crossbar. The secondary title should be to the right of the name, set in a lighter weight with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the background predominantly white and overexposed?
Is there a solid blue bar at the very top?
Is the text entirely lowercase and white?
Is the subject positioned off-center to the right?

adjustableVariables: Width of the blue header bar
Intensity of the background geometric shadows
Tracking width of the subtitle text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Precise alignment of the header bar
Smooth skin retouching typical of 2000s glamor

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue bar is perfectly horizontal and touches the top edge.
Check that the white background doesn't lose all detail in the shadows.
Verify the text is legible against the blue background.
Confirm the subject's skin tones look natural despite the high-key lighting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, right-aligned portrait with a solid-color top header bar containing minimalist, geometric, lowercase typography.
